method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation incorporating amendments up to the Administration Amendment Act 2022 (No. 5 of 2022, in operation 30 March 2022); last reprint listed Reprint 12 as at 15 April 2016; legislation.wa.gov.au mrdoc_49096, retrieved 7 September 2026. No subsidiary instrument deposited: the s 14A legacy sums (Administration (Intestacy Legacy Amounts) Orders 2023 and 2025), the s 139 proclaimed ceiling and the probate rules' period are inputs.

scope: ss 6-8, 12A, 12B, 13(1a), 14 (Table items 1-11, (1A), (1B), (2), (2a)-(2b), (3), (3a), (4)), 14A(1), 15(1)-(3), (5), 25, 32, 33(1), 36, 37, 42, 43(1)(b), 44, 55, 71, 139(1)(a), 143A, Part V (no duty), Fourth Schedule cll 1-3; out: insolvent estates, sureties, revocation, special grants, accounts procedure, resealing, caveats, infants' shares, s 15(4), machinery
seat: the heir or next of kin (spouse, de facto partner, child, parent, sibling, grandparent, uncle or aunt) and the executor or would-be administrator of the estate

roles: I am a member of the family of someone who has died
I am the executor of a will, or want to be granted administration of an estate
I am given something by a will
I am owed money by someone who has died

situation_parameters.name: what the person who died left
situation_parameters.type: What the person who died left
situation_parameters.does_not_arise: a will that disposes of all their property (the s 14 questions); a will that leaves some of their property undisposed of or a will that disposes of all their property (the s 25 questions); no will (the s 71 and s 37 questions)
